svg.title: Index calculation
svg.desc: Feature reorder, conditional metadata read, group split, and optional local deduplication. Solid bars: logical execution/access scopes; hollow dashed bars: unconsumed requests. Blue H2D, red D2H/host sync, purple AllToAll, amber request wait, green stream dependency. forward(features) ShardedModule creates EC context Optional feature reorder: only when input key order must change features.permute(_features_order) align input key order with sharding plan length_per_key() → D2H → current_stream.synchronize() Cache host counts; split below reuses them. If reorder is skipped, conditional read 01 occurs in split instead. permute_2D_sparse_data permute lengths and values activities [1-7] permute lengths/data + CUB scans Split features by sharding group features.split(_feature_splits) Reads length_per_key, then builds offset_per_key on the CPU. Cached counts: no D2H. If reorder was skipped: read 01 may occur here, not twice. Optional local deduplication: use_index_dedup enabled jagged_unique_indices unique is local and happens before row bucketize; optional use_index_dedup activities [8-45] offset cumsum -> linearize -> sort/unique -> delinearize save ctx.reverse_indices original position -> local unique position
svg.text: Feature reorder, conditional metadata read, group split, and optional local deduplication.
Activation / access scope; nested bars = self-calls
Messages and file references link to source ↗
Example activity IDs and sizes vary by execution; source links identify TorchRec callsites for backend work.

g.text: Optional feature reorder: only when input key order must change

g.title: D2H / HOST SYNC · CPU needs CUDA values
g.text: Uncached, nonempty CUDA lengths only; int64[F], 8F bytes.
Cache host counts; split below reuses them. If reorder is skipped, conditional read 01
Reads length_per_key, then builds offset_per_key on the CPU. Cached counts: no D2H. If
reorder was skipped: read 01 may occur here, not twice.
unique is local and happens before row bucketize; optional

svg.text: 01 matches inventory row 01: first uncached access in permute, or in split if permutation is skipped. Count this read at most once.
F is the pre-bucket feature count. Fixed-stride, nonempty CUDA lengths produce 8F bytes of host counts; cached or empty inputs skip D2H.
reverse_indices is not used yet; it is consumed only after output AllToAll and unbucketization.
Activities [8-10] build input offsets; the sort/scan kernels that follow are implementation children of fbgemm.jagged_unique_indices.
Activity IDs, sizes, kernel names and optimizer details illustrate one execution configuration; they are not fixed for every run.
TorchRec 1d87b8f79b7b / Logical scopes, not measured durations. Request wait consumes a handle; stream dependencies order GPU work.
